description: Retrieve annual youth employment rate by educational attainment for EU/EEA countries from Eurostat (dataset: yth_empl_010, SDMX 2.1). Returns employment rate (% of age group) for youth aged 15–24 (default), 15–19, 15–29, 20–24, or 20–29, across all ISCED education levels combined. Country accepts ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (DE, FR, ES, IT) or EU27_2020. Data covers 2005–present (with ~1 year lag). Useful for EU youth policy research, labour market analysis, and education-employment gap studies. Source: Eurostat LFS, CC BY 4.0, no auth required.

age_group.description: Youth age group: Y15-24=15 to 24 years (default), Y15-19=15 to 19 years, Y15-29=15 to 29 years, Y20-24=20 to 24 years, Y20-29=20 to 29 years

country.description: Eurostat geo code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country (e.g. DE, FR, ES) or EU aggregate (EU27_2020)

since_year.description: First year to include (integer, e.g. 2010). Defaults to 2005.

name: eurostat2.employment.youth
